mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide increases urinary zinc excretion and may impair iron absorption through altered gastrointestinal pH and electrolyte balance, while thiazides can cause hypokalemia that may be compounded by iron supplementation effects.
action: Monitor for anemia and electrolyte imbalances; separate administration by 2+ hours and consider periodic iron and potassium level monitoring in patients on chronic thiazide therapy.
